registerSchemas.description: Operational record of who is authorized for access and when approvals/revocations occur.

Document approved privilege/role change for an existing user.
Document removal of access for least privilege / offboarding / review.
Periodic access review (e.g., quarterly) with findings and actions.
ISSO-flagged anomaly during weekly review of access authorizations (dormant account, unjustified grant, missing approval, etc.).

registerSchemas.description: Defines roles and maps users to roles; used to demonstrate least privilege and duty separation.

entry_types.short_help: Update role definitions and privileges.
Record updates to which users hold a role.

registerSchemas.description: Identifies incompatible duties/roles and documents reviews and approved exceptions.

entry_types.short_help: Annual or change-driven review of SoD matrix.
Document an approved SoD exception with compensating controls.

entry_types.short_help: Record MFA enrollment event for a user.
Record password reset with verification method.
Record revocation of an authenticator/credential.
Periodic check that privileged access requires MFA/strong auth where applicable.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks completion of security awareness and role-based training.

Record annual recurring training completion.
Record role-specific training (admins, IR team, etc.).

registerSchemas.description: Records required pre-employment/personnel screening activities.

entry_types.short_help: Record that required screening was completed prior to access.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks termination/offboarding actions and timely access revocation.

entry_types.short_help: Record offboarding and access revocation actions.
Record disablement of an account on a system.

registerSchemas.description: Documents routine audit log/SIEM reviews and investigations.

entry_types.short_help: Routine daily audit/siem review record.
Weekly review summary and findings.
Investigation record for a specific alert.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks audit logging configuration, retention, protection, and time-sync validation.

Record change to log retention settings.
Periodic validation of time sync across relevant systems.

registerSchemas.description: Continuous monitoring/attestation records supporting ongoing control effectiveness.

entry_types.short_help: Periodic operational check for a specific control.
Attestation that a system remains within baseline/required posture.
Review ongoing exceptions and compensating controls.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks incidents and IR exercises/tests with severity, actions, and outcomes.

entry_types.short_help: Record incident detection and initial triage.
Ongoing incident lifecycle updates.
Incident response test/tabletop activity record.

registerSchemas.description: Records maintenance activities including remote sessions and approvals.

entry_types.short_help: Record planned maintenance activities.
Record emergency maintenance with justification and approval.
Record remote maintenance session details and supervision.
Acknowledge a detected break-glass account sign-in. Created as draft by EnclaveWatch detection; admin completes acknowledgment fields to finalize.

Record approved connection to external systems.
Periodic inventory/update of controlled media (if used).

entry_types.short_help: Record media sanitization event.
Record media destruction event.
Record return of media/device to vendor with chain-of-custody info.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks visitors to controlled areas including purpose, host, and access scope.

entry_types.short_help: Record visitor entry/exit and access scope.
Document exceptions to standard visitor procedures.

Record physical security issues and remediation.

Record backout/rollback activity.

Update risk treatment and status.
Periodic review of risk register and status.

registerSchemas.description: Tracks assessments, findings, severities, owners, and retest outcomes.

Record a specific finding mapped to a control.
Record retest results for a finding.

Record procedure/SOP review.

registerSchemas.description: Documents who is authorized to access the CUI Vault remotely (Azure Bastion, VPN, or any other channel) and the conditions of that access. Required by 3.1.12, 3.1.13, 3.1.14, 3.1.15.

entry_types.short_help: Document approval for a user to access CUI Vault remotely.
Annual recertification that each remote-access authorization is still valid.

registerSchemas.description: Inventory of every external (non-org-owned) system permitted to interact with the CUI boundary, including the data shared, the authorization basis, and the trust relationship. Required by 3.1.20.

entry_types.short_help: Document approval for an external system to connect to the CUI Vault.
Record removal of an external system connection.

registerSchemas.description: Per-event approval log for any use of portable storage media (USB, optical, removable drive) within the CUI boundary. Default architecture has portable storage prohibited; this register exists to document approved exceptions. Required by 3.1.21, 3.8.7, 3.8.8.

entry_types.short_help: Approve a one-time or scoped use of portable storage in the CUI boundary.
Revoke a previously-approved portable storage exception.

registerSchemas.description: Periodic snapshots of every user, service principal/managed identity, and device with vault scope. Each entry is one cadence run's full inventory at a point in time; the register's history is the audit trail of identity-set changes. Diffs between consecutive snapshots surface adds/removes for review. Primary evidence for §3.5.1 (identify users, processes, devices); incidental evidence for §3.5.6, §3.1.5, §3.1.6.

entry_types.short_help: Full point-in-time inventory of users, service principals, and devices with vault scope.
